remaining_risks: PDF/Word client-side downloads rely on browser-level file generation APIs (Blob, URL.createObjectURL, and react-pdf iframe/blob streams). Browser-specific download policies may apply.
Scope creep before target-user validation remains a risk.
Overbuilding into SaaS features too early remains a risk.
Accidental sensitive data handling remains a risk; v0.9 backup exports contain unencrypted field records and require explicit security disclaimers.
recommended_next_step: Proceed to Phase 2: Study Workspace & Setup Flow (connecting study selector to IndexedDB, study creation, cloning UI, and study-level configuration).
